Examined doctor output, help and templates: no user-visible behavior or scaffold changed; the spec documents approach, decisions, known gaps and that F5 remains open; code comments explain memo lifetime and cut rules.

Examined authority boundaries: a dynamic Authorize callback disables the memo; unauthorized/missing/duplicate identities resolve identically to the live path; snapshots never cross operations; final audit still refuses changed inputs including same-size/restored-mtime edits.
